name: Spark of Freedom
label: Quest
description: A fire elemental’s display ends with the creature exhausted. Its attention had been fixed on the Dark Irons, and the others are relieved it did not turn…
intro: A fire elemental’s display ends with the creature exhausted. Its attention had been fixed on the Dark Irons, and the others are relieved it did not turn on them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!
Glad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!
